polys_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentation format to a binary mask as a 2D numpy float32 array
mask_to_bbox: compute the tight bounding box coordinates of a binary segmentation mask
flip_segms: left-right flip each segmentation mask in a list supporting both polygon and RLE formats
rle_mask_nms: perform greedy non-maximum suppression on RLE masks using IOU, IOMA, or CONTAINMENT overlap modes
rle_masks_to_boxes: compute bounding boxes for each mask in a list of RLE encoded segmentation masks
